about: Berkay Vuran is a product leader with 7+ years across AI, telco, health, logistics and proptech. Explore his CV, showcase, writing and 13 live AI-built products.

projects.d: A visual cemetery for dead products and features. Browse 12 famous product deaths with PM lessons, or bury your own failed features with epitaphs and causes of death.
An interactive choose-your-own-adventure simulation with 10 real-world PM dilemmas. Every choice maps to a 5-axis radar profile — grounded in PMBOK, Kotter, and behavioral psychology.
A daily meal tracking journal to log your food intake and monitor nutrition habits. Simple, no sign-up required.
A browser-based game tribute to Grafi2000, celebrating the beloved Noel Dayı meme from Turkish internet culture. A nostalgic dive into early 2000s internet folklore.
An implicit sexism scale that measures subtle gender biases through scientifically grounded questions. Self-awareness is the first step toward a fairer world.
A fun recreation of the legendary HackerTyper experience. Mash any keys and watch as terminal code fills your screen — look like a movie hacker in seconds.
A subscription-based appointment platform with a rich dashboard. Designed to simplify recurring reservations and subscription management for service businesses.
A minimalist flow-state timer with ambient background animations. Built to help you enter deep focus and achieve peak productivity without distraction.
A visual showcase of glassmorphism UI components in Pro Glass Edition. Demonstrates advanced CSS design patterns — cards, modals, inputs and more with stunning glass effects.
A news aggregator hub dedicated to combat sports — boxing, MMA, kickboxing and more. Built for fans who want all the action in one place.
A retrospective tool for product teams to capture, organize, and reflect on lessons learned from projects and sprints. Because the best team never stops learning.
An interactive quiz game for Contact Center professionals. Master CCaaS and conversational AI terminology through gamified learning — because boring training is a product failure.
A practice exam portal for ISTQB CTFL v4.0 certification. Timed mock tests, instant feedback, and detailed explanations — because passing a testing exam requires actually testing yourself.
